source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper's Bernoulli appendix defines the nominal-label Horvitz--Thompson/IPW estimator as (Cp_k)^(-1) times the sum over clusters with label k of the within-cluster gamma/beta weighted welfare, and proves its unbiasedness for the CR-mixture welfare.

Joo establishes local Gaussian-regret convergence and plug-in covariance MMR optimality, and numerically constructs least-favourable-prior Gaussian rules; it does not state an exact-hit-polytope outer-design result.
The article develops asymptotic optimality theory for treatment rules through limits of experiments under average and minimax risk criteria.
The paper develops unbiased estimators, conservative variances, testing, and power analysis for direct and spillover effects in two-stage randomized experiments.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies randomized-saturation designs and optimizes experimental design for statistical power under interference, rather than exact-slice policy-selection simple regret.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the headline comparison operational by deriving a data-driven pre-experiment allocation rule and a finite-sample or explicitly uniform guarantee for its achieved mechanism-loss ratio.
Extend the exact-slice target to heterogeneous cluster sizes using the floor-ceiling deployment mixture, and state whether the hit-mass frontier transfers under cluster- and person-weighted welfare.
Release the interval-arithmetic specification and reproducible certificate for the asymmetric three-policy example so that the claimed optimizer boxes and risk intervals are independently checkable.
